# Job Application Tracker

> An open-source (Apache-2.0), self-hosted, local-first web app for tracking a job search,
> built for software engineers. It tracks applications, recruiters and agencies (one
> recruiter can have many roles), configurable interview stages with timestamped history,
> numbered interview rounds described in the user's own words ("Round 2 · System design
> test"), duplicate-submission warnings, Markdown notes, attachments and exported emails,
> CV and cover-letter versions, calls with recruiters and the roles they pitch (to apply
> for or pass on), an Overview home page, a "Next actions" page for stalled applications and
> who to chase, a timeline across everything, and insights: a Sankey diagram of the
> funnel, conversion and time per stage, direct vs recruiter outcomes and a recruiter
> scorecard. It never scrapes job boards or contacts
> anyone, and all data stays in one local directory outside the code.

Status: ready and in daily use (version 0.1.0, not yet bumped to 1.0); every planned feature
is built (see CHANGELOG.md). Available now: an Overview home page (counts, pipeline, what needs
attention, what's coming up, recent activity, a numbered "How it works"), a Timeline across
every role, application, company, agency and person (by day or as lanes, one row per role
from the call it came up on to its outcome; a Timeline button on each person, company and agency page opens
`/timeline?about=contact:<id>&period=all` (or `company:`, `agency:`); `GET /api/v1/timeline`),
a Next actions page at `/next-actions` (your own to-dos, on their own or about a person,
company, agency, role or application, `/api/v1/todos`; follow-ups due, applications gone quiet,
interviews coming up, one-click follow-up, snooze and Ghosted, waiting to hear back, replies to read, and chased / ghosted / not interested for people, with a ghost before a ghosted person's name across the app, a Ghosted filter on Recruiters and Not a ghost to take it off; favourite people (`favourite` on contacts) starred next to their name across the app, filtered and listed first; "usually replies within N working days" per person, weekends excluded (`replies` and `usual_reply_days` on contacts), with "longer than usual" when you're waiting past it), person pages with booked and logged
calls and meetings (`/api/v1/meetings`; one person per email address and LinkedIn profile;
merge two records of one person, `POST /api/v1/contacts/{id}/merge`), roles to decide before applying (a Roles page;
pitched by whom, on which call; apply, mark interested (tracked at the starting stage, role status `interested`, or `closed` with `closed_as`, the stage it ended at, when every application closed before Applied) or pass; a page per role with its files, such as the
job description, which also show on the application; `/api/v1/role-summaries`), renaming and
deleting, applications list and Kanban board (move between any stages), application
pages (with an "At a glance" card: what needs attention, for how long, and key dates as
"3 weeks ago"), company, recruiter and agency pages, recruiter CRM, numbered interview rounds (rescheduled from the Interviews page, and marked so), duplicate
warnings, Markdown notes as real files, links, file attachments and `.eml` import onto the
timeline, versioned CVs and cover letters, an Insights page (the whole picture: one Sankey
diagram of every role from its source, through a recruiter, referred or found yourself, to
passed, deciding, or its stages and what's still waiting at each, `GET
/api/v1/insights/whole-flow`; a Sankey diagram of stage flows filtered by date and route; conversion and median time per stage; direct vs recruiter
outcomes; weekly activity; a recruiter and agency scorecard; and a Recruiter
conversations tab: calls, roles pitched, applied or passed, where pitched roles went, time
to decide, per person and agency, and why you passed, `GET /api/v1/insights/conversations`),
an A/B test of CV and cover-letter versions (CV files attached to applications, roles or people (a CV sent to a recruiter), identical by content, become versions in one go: `GET /api/v1/cv-files`, `POST /api/v1/cv-files/adopt`, optionally for chosen `application_ids`; heard back, screens or interviews, offers, a 95%
range, and Fisher's exact test between two; `GET /api/v1/insights/documents`),
offers compared side by side
(salary, bonus, equity, pension and holiday, or day rate, IR35 and length, with a
worth-a-year figure and reply deadlines in Next actions), git-backed snapshots, a one-click
zip backup of the whole data directory (`GET /api/v1/backup/archive` or `jat archive`),
restore (`jat restore`), and full-text search across everything, notes included
(`GET /api/v1/search?q=`, or press / in the app).

Stack: Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Alembic and SQLite (with a JSON Lines export
committed to the user's private data repo); React 19, TypeScript, Mantine, TanStack
Router/Query and d3-sankey. Run with `uv run jat --data-dir <dir> serve`
(http://127.0.0.1:8770); try demo data with `uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py /tmp/jat-demo`.
The JSON API is documented at http://127.0.0.1:8770/api/docs; insights live under
`/api/v1/insights/` (`whole-flow`, `flow`, `stats`, `activity`, `scorecard`, `conversations`,
`documents`).
